source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Use Ireasoning MIB browser professional:
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Open Ireasoning MIB browser, load the MIB files.
4. Setup the settings of MIB browser to access BMC according to the WEB UI SNMPv3 settings.
5. Left-click on the $target and expand subtree.
6. Right-Click on the node and use "Get Next" or "Get Subtree" to get all the values of the $target.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
Use NetSNMP to check.
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Put the mib files into the netsnmp search path.
http://www.net-snmp.org/docs/FAQ.html#Where_should_I_put_my_MIB_files_
4. Use NetSNMP "get type" of command(s) to retrieve the values of the $target from BMC.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: snmpwalk (net-snmp), BMC SNMP agent must be enabled + community configured
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- SNMP "errorlogs" monitoring reads specific BMC MIB data via the SNMP agent; from a 2nd management host run `snmpwalk -v2c -c ${SNMP_COMMUNITY:?operator must set SNMP community (v2c) or v3 creds} "$BMC_IP" .1.3.6.1.4.1.8072.2.3.2.1.2 | grep -i log (or walk the vendor MIB subtree once the SNMP community/v3 creds + MIB are configured). Enable + point SNMP agent first.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL snmpwalk output for the error-log OID subtree so the user confirms the errorlogs SNMP data is correct.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: SNMP queries need a management host + enabled/configured SNMP agent on the BMC (community/v3 + firewall); enabling SNMP is a config change, and some BMC SNMP sets expose credentials - use read-only community.

original_test_intent: Retrieve a bounded, Project-defined BMC error-log record set over SNMPv3 and verify record identity, source, severity and chronology for an approved baseline or event window while preserving pre-existing forensic evidence.
original_method: The source first instructs clearing dmesg/syslog/SEL, then an engineer enables SNMPv3 and uses IReasoning Get Next/Get Subtree on undefined `$target`; Criteria switch to Net-SNMP without defining the log table, window or expected records.
manual_activity: An engineer must configure SNMPv3, approve the log schema/window and expected baseline or safe event, and authorize any separate log-clear action only after preserving evidence. The agent can then retrieve, normalize and compare bounded read-only records.
required_inputs: vendor MIB module/version and exact error-log table/root and column OIDs
record index/ID, source, severity, timestamp/timezone, message and acknowledgement semantics
baseline/no-event or approved event/stimulus and expected record set
start/end time, maximum rows/pages, rollover, retention and truncation rules
BMC/manager clock synchronization and independent SEL/WebUI reference
least-privilege SNMPv3 profile/ACL and approved client equivalence/cleanup policy
safety_requirements: Do not execute the source's `Clear logs` instruction automatically; preserve and hash existing dmesg/syslog/SEL/BMC evidence first, and require a separately approved, recoverability-aware plan if clearing is truly part of Project execution.
Never clear, acknowledge, delete, rotate or mutate log records through SNMP or another interface in this monitoring checkpoint.
Do not use v2c, the generic `.1.3.6.1.4.1.8072...` example, grep-only output or an unbounded full subtree walk.
Bound retrieval by exact objects plus row/page/time limits and record truncation; preserve typed indexes and raw ordering.
Redact credentials, tokens, network identities, serials and incident payloads before persistence without removing event identity/severity/chronology.
Stop on critical unexpected events, unbounded growth, write-capable objects, BMC resource stress or secret exposure; preserve first evidence and do not retry automatically.
agent_execution_scope: After engineer setup, query exact approved error-log objects through bounded SNMPv3 GET/GETNEXT/WALK with explicit page/row/time limits.
Normalize timestamps/time zones and severity using documented semantics, detect rollover/truncation and correlate expected records with independent SEL/WebUI data.
Do not clear/acknowledge logs, generate an event unless separately approved, operate WebUI, claim IReasoning coverage when only Net-SNMP ran or issue a DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the log table/schema, collection bounds, expected baseline/event and evidence-redaction policy.
Preserve pre-existing logs, approve any safe external stimulus or separate clear operation, configure/restore SNMPv3 and approve tool equivalence.
Investigate critical/unexpected records and issue PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The command uses the wrong security mode and an unrelated demonstration OID; generic grep plus `FULL` output cannot prove record schema, severity or chronology and risks unbounded sensitive-data capture.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use exact vendor error-log table OIDs over SNMPv3 with deterministic row/page/time bounds, full typed columns, pre-storage redaction and no clear/acknowledge operation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IReasoning, SNMPv3 WebUI/account setup, undefined `$target`, Net-SNMP Criteria, source `Clear logs` instruction and 10/5-minute values remain preserved evidence; the destructive clear is flagged rather than silently executed.

modernized_recommendation.status: PROJECT ERROR-LOG SCHEMA AND WINDOW CONTRACT REQUIRED
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Snapshot existing evidence, define a finite log table and baseline/event window, retrieve typed rows with bounded pagination over SNMPv3, normalize chronology/severity and correlate with SEL/WebUI while leaving all log state intact.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The identified BMC firmware/log schema and matching vendor MIB.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC firmware, MIB, client, clock/timezone and log-schema versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor SNMP error-log table, severity/timestamp/pagination documentation and Project event matrix.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds deterministic schema/window, pagination and evidence-preservation safeguards; it does not erase the original clear instruction or replace the original IReasoning checkpoint.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Read-only bounded collection validates retrieval/semantics, not log clear/acknowledge behavior or event injection; Net-SNMP cannot claim IReasoning UI coverage without approval.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Objects/schema, expected window/events, pagination/rollover, clock reference, redaction and client decision.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Clock drift, rollover, retention and asynchronous record insertion can reorder or evict entries, requiring timestamp/index-aware correlation.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may approve a non-destructive baseline instead of clearing logs, define a safe event stimulus and approve Net-SNMP instead of IReasoning, but must record original/actual method, coverage difference, collection bounds and any untested clear/stimulus/client behavior.
expected_evidence: pre-existing dmesg/syslog/SEL/BMC log snapshot/hash and explicit no-clear status
approved error-log table schema, expected baseline/event and collection window/bounds
redacted SNMPv3 WebUI/account/ACL configuration and cleanup artifacts
vendor MIB identity with exact OID/type/index/severity/timestamp mapping
bounded typed raw rows with pagination/rollover/truncation diagnostics and redaction scan
timestamped correlation with independent SEL/WebUI, tool/coverage statement, BMC health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure requires IReasoning/SNMPv3 and destructive log clearing while Criteria changes to Net-SNMP, `$target` and acceptance remain undefined, and DeepSeek changes to v2c plus an unrelated generic unbounded output. The read-only error-log retrieval purpose remains identifiable, but clearing must remain a separately approved coverage item.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Log schema, expected event/window, pagination and redaction are Project execution-readiness inputs for a clear monitoring purpose. Once supplied and manually configured, bounded read-only retrieval is automatable; permanent BLOCKED is not justified, while the source clear step remains unexecuted without separate approval.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains hybrid execution but rejects v2c, generic/unbounded output and grep evidence, adding deterministic schema, chronology, redaction and no-clear controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Changes BLOCKED to REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION under ED-36 while preserving hard stops for mutation, unbounded capture or secret exposure.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Independently confirms its classification and strengthens evidence preservation, rollover/pagination and the source-clear coverage distinction.

review_improvement: Makes pre-existing forensic preservation and bounded chronology part of acceptance, preventing both destructive baseline creation and an unbounded sensitive log dump from masquerading as error-log validation.
independent_technical_reasoning: The log-monitoring purpose is clear, but a deterministic verdict needs a schema, finite window and expected records. Those are Project inputs. The source's generic clear step is destructive and cannot be automatic; preserving it as an unexecuted separate checkpoint maintains coverage while allowing the bounded read-only core to be classified REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION.
